designPrompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE COMPLETE MOBILE ONBOARDING SCREEN DESIGN for Rakky Ride. Flat front-facing screen canvas, portrait aspect ratio 1:2, ideally 1024x2048. No physical phone frame, no perspective, no collage, no mockup background. This is a finished full-page UI composition, NOT just an illustration. White-forward refined ride-hailing app, forest green primary #176B17, charcoal typography, soft mint accents, Inter-like sans serif. Header near top: small restrained wordmark 'Rakky Ride' left and 'Skip' right. Large comfortable white margins. The SMALL stylized 3D illustration occupies only about 30% of the full screen height, centered in the upper-middle on a faint mint circular gradient halo, not inside a giant image card. Art style is clean soft matte clay / smooth toy-like 3D with rounded simplified shapes, gentle ambient occlusion, orthographic camera, delightful but grown-up. NOT photorealistic, NOT realistic automobile advertising, NO brushed metal, NO shiny chrome, NO intricate textures, NO complex scenic background, NO maps. Beneath illustration at about 56% screen height: centered short bold charcoal headline, then a gray sentence of at most two lines. Near bottom: three small progress dots, then a wide rounded forest-green button with white text, and a small 'Already a member? Log in' line. Keep obvious separation between artwork, heading, description, and controls. All UI text must be exactly as specified. No other text, no feature chips, no badges, no decorative cards. Illustration: a charming simplified forest-green rounded compact car in front three-quarter view, with smooth charcoal windows and four simple tires. One small mint location pin and two low abstract ivory building blocks behind, subtle ground shadow, lots of air. Headline exactly: 'Your next ride,\nmade easy.' Description exactly: 'Choose your destination. We’ll take care of the journey.' First progress dot active. Primary button exactly: 'Next' with a small right arrow.

illustrationPrompts.prompt: Edit this complete onboarding mockup into a standalone illustration asset for implementing the design. Keep ONLY its central clean stylized matte clay 3D scene, matching exactly the shapes, colors, arrangement, friendly simplified plastic/clay material and orthographic art style of that illustration. Preserve all scene objects and their natural soft ground shadow. Remove ALL typography, wordmark, header, buttons, navigation, dots, screen borders and UI. Do not create a screen or phone mockup. Square canvas 1024x1024 with the isolated illustration centered and occupying about 80% of the width, ample transparent margins on every side. Background must be genuinely transparent alpha, including corners; remove the white page and mint glow backdrop (the app will draw its own subtle theme-aware glow). No text, no letters, no photorealism, no extra objects, no cropping of objects.
